content: wj-su/glue-local-runner uses docker-compose with two services: LocalStack (S3 emulation) + custom Glue container; removes hive-site.xml to force local Hive Metastore instead of Glue Data Catalog. Exposes Jupyter at :8888, jobs run via docker exec + spark-submit. No single CLI entrypoint script; README follows Features/How It Works/Getting Started/Usage/Project Structure/Customization.
